decision.reason: [ev-27aaf3747c01] is just a one-line commit title. It says repo URLs with `ssh`/`altssh` subdomains are now allowed to match webhook payloads. It does not give the previous matching behaviour, which Git providers or hostnames are affected, or the exact matching rule. That leaves no concrete before/after value and no precise environment condition. The real detail sits in issues #19314 and #15700 and PR #21227, none of which are in the evidence, so the PR or issue text is needed to write the change and applicability aspects.
